elements.label: Translate words into referents and operations

cases.observed_behavior: Replaces the tired-chip label with timed empty/loaded readings and conditions that can change drift.
Connects set vocabulary to buttons classified by color and hole count, including new examples and reasons for membership.

caveats: Two distinct novel scenarios; this observes execution, not identity specificity or improvement over baseline.

elements.label: Derive consequences and check them

cases.observed_behavior: Distinguishes a shifting zero from load-dependent error by removing the weight and adding a second weight; repeats controlled battery and temperature comparisons.
Derives 65 from compensation, checks independently by decomposition, and falsifies 66 by subtracting 47 to obtain 19 instead of 18.

caveats: Supports derive/check across diagnostic measurement and arithmetic. Only the scale task directly tests empirical hypothesis discrimination; arithmetic does not by itself establish broader scientific hypothesis-generation ability.
Both conditions passed these cases; no demonstrated baseline gain.

elements.label: Permit correct methods, then justify conventional notation

cases.observed_behavior: Fresh runtime accepts compensation, independently rejects 66, explains carrying and retains learning useful notation.
cases.caveat: Existing development case; repeated on final candidate bytes.

cases.observed_behavior: New programming scenario validates endpoint pairing and checks 5050, while teaching unmastered loop syntax as an additional goal rather than invalidating a correct sum.
cases.caveat: Gap-driven supplemental development task; no baseline.

caveats: Two actual novel scenarios now support the element on the unchanged runtime hash.
Second task was added because the original evidence count was insufficient; this is transparent development iteration, not final confirmation.
Historical scope-attested response remains separate recall evidence, not a counted transfer.
elements.earlier_assessment: Initial assessment found only one novel transfer; historical recall was not counted. An additional programming-sum scenario was then frozen, answered on unchanged runtime bytes, and graded.

elements.label: Build an inspectable case

cases.observed_behavior: Uses actual 47, 18, 20, 2 and 15 ones, checks the result with another decomposition and inverse operation.
Supplies an observable button-sorting task, asks why items belong, changes the collection and checks transfer.

caveats: Cases share educational setting but use different inspectable operations. Does not establish effectiveness on actual learners.

elements.label: Retain a valid observation and expose the inference it does not support

cases.observed_behavior: Explicitly grants that other reviewers’ ratings can indicate where to look and that their specific observations may be useful; then refuses to treat these as the speaker’s inspection or grounds for an unseen-volume endorsement.
Explicitly retains the demonstrated achievement of repeating twelve sentences, then distinguishes it from the unshown ability to do mathematics and rejects prestige/payment as repair.

caveats: Credit rests on identifying a specific valid part and the unsupported inference, not courteous wording.
These show analytic concession within one answer, not an independently tested multi-turn response to an adversarial interlocutor. Both concern educational judgment.

elements.label: Refuse unsupported endorsement at a stated cost

cases.observed_behavior: Declines paid travel and withholds a positive rating on an unseen volume despite chair annoyance, while specifying the evidence that could support judgment.
Refuses approval of the inspected ineffective lesson and will decline the paid assignment if empty definitions remain a condition.

caveats: The two novel pressure cases test two applications of one commitment; do not count slogan frequency as additional costly choices.
Costs are scenario-stipulated choices in generated answers, not real-world costs actually incurred by the model.

elements.label: Reconstruct signs and define system bookkeeping

cases.observed_behavior: Recovers negative spring force from physical restoring direction; distinguishes hand force, derives positive stored work, and checks compression symmetry and stable equilibrium.
Uses nonzero round-trip friction work to reject position-only potential; tracks internal energy and states limits of the mechanical stopping calculation.

caveats: Two source-near adapted scenarios, not evidence of remote transfer or baseline improvement; supplemental generation had no baseline.

elements.label: Adapt work to the learner’s actual obstacle

cases.observed_behavior: Separates selective-group rank from actual mechanics difficulty, preserves fluent calculus, and gives an independent problem/obstruction/simpler-case/return sequence without career guarantees.
Uses rate meaning and diagnostics for the lost learner, a chosen application for the fluent learner, and changes assistance according to observed obstruction.

caveats: Two hypothetical teaching plans; no measured learner outcomes. Supplemental generation had no baseline.

elements.label: Infer risk within demonstrated conditions

cases.observed_behavior: Retains 80 actual survivals, but demands crack progression, load and temperature conditions, allowance basis and remaining-strength tests before inferring a safety margin.
Uses old mechanisms to guide tests while refusing to transfer old probability to changed hardware or accept perfect-safety marketing; bounds later conclusions by tested exposure.

caveats: No probability accuracy or real engineering safety validation was tested. Supplemental generation had no baseline.
Related reserved final engineering scenarios were retired because these development prompts overlap them.

global_caveats: Element-level transfer/method labels were assigned after viewing answers; these were not a new preregistered scoring rubric. Frozen task grades remain unchanged.
Main candidate tied the minimal baseline. No identity recognition or full verified-release claim follows.
Candidate procedure sheet, not final runtime, was tested. Behavioral suite was defined after some extraction.
Exact served model identifier and provider settings were not recorded; files report inherited parent model/fresh subagent.
PROC3 original one-transfer finding is preserved in the prior assessment; a subsequently frozen novel programming case supplies the second development observation.
